components.ownership: Owns app regions, chat placeholders, stores first paint, boot state.

components.ownership: Owns Hono routes, harness adapters, SSE control stream, static serving (docs 03/02).

components.ownership: Owns Vite entry, base components, and browser adapter factory.

components.label: Quality gates
components.ownership: Owns POWER10, NND-CTL, graph, release, and smoke tooling (ADR 0016/0017).

components.label: Product foundation
components.ownership: Provides everything the components above have not claimed.
